title: Finite measures agreeing on smooth test functions in an open set agree on functions vanishing outside it
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ν₁ and ν₂ be finite measures on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P, and let O ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Suppose ∫ ψ dν₁ = ∫ ψ dν₂ for every C^∞ function ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ (smooth of every finite order) with compact support and tsupport ψ ⊆ O. Then ∫ b dν₁ = ∫ b dν₂ for every function b : ℝ^P → ℝ with b(x) = 0 for all x ∉ O. Integrals are Bochner integrals, so a non-integrable function has integral 0; no measurability or boundedness of b is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν₁ ν₂ : Measure (Eucl P)), IsFiniteMeasure ν₁ → IsFiniteMeasure ν₂ → ∀ O : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen O → (∀ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O → ∫ x, ψ x ∂ν₁ = ∫ x, ψ x ∂ν₂) → ∀ b : Eucl P → ℝ, (∀ x, x ∉ O → b x = 0) → ∫ x, b x ∂ν₁ = ∫ x, b x ∂ν₂
